sources.title: AvinabhDutta-Dev/assamese-sentiment-muril · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Assamese Sentiment Analysis — Fine-Tuned MuRIL This repository contains a fine-tuned MuRIL (Multilingual Representations for Indian Languages) transformer model optimized for binary sentiment analysis on Assamese textual reviews. It maps localized Assamese content into binary sentiment classes (Positive and Negative).

sources.snippet: AI & ML interests NLP for low-resource languages (Assamese, Bengali), transfer learning, transformer models (MuRIL, IndicBERT, XLM-R), sentiment analysis, RAG systems

sources.title: GitHub - AvinabhDutta-Dev/assamese-sentiment-analysis: Comparative ...
sources.snippet: A comparative study benchmarking five machine learning and deep learning architectures for binary sentiment classification on Assamese-language movie reviews — built to address the near-total absence of sentiment analysis resources for Assamese, a low-resource Indic language.

sources.title: GitHub - AvinabhDutta-Dev/assamese-sentiment-live-demo: Live ...
sources.snippet: A live, interactive Gradio app for Assamese sentiment classification, powered by a fine-tuned MuRIL model (96.33% accuracy). Deployed on Render for free public hosting, embedded directly in my portfolio.
